steps.title: What is changing here?
steps.body: Every NASA variable that applies to this glacier is tested. The ice itself is one of them.

steps.title: Is it real, or is it chance?
steps.body: People have walked out and measured this glacier almost every year since the 1870s. The retreat is steady and large, not one hot summer.

steps.title: Is it the climate?
steps.body: Nothing is pumped here. No reservoir, no irrigation, no change in land use. Temperature is the driver, and the ice answers.

narrative: Some changes are not our doing, and it matters that we say so. A detector that blames people for everything is not a detector.
caveats: A retreating glacier is not a water-supply forecast.
Ice loss here is slow enough to see only decade by decade.
